destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Area, city, district, or neighborhood to search in. Example: Nairobi, Westlands, Kisumu.

search_term.title: Search term
search_term.description: What the user is looking for in that area. Example: hotel, salon, restaurant, gym.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Legacy direct URL batch mode for known businesses.

website.title: Website
website.description: Public website URL for the business.

url.title: URL
url.description: The public page to inspect for contact details.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional alias for the business name.

csv_file.title: CSV file
csv_file.description: Optional CSV path for a direct business batch. Kept only for compatibility; the repo does not track sensitive company lists.

google_places_enabled.title: Google Places enabled
google_places_enabled.description: Set to true only when you have authorized Google Places API access and a valid API key configured.

google_places_api_key.title: Google Places API key
google_places_api_key.description: Optional Google Places API key used only when the actor is explicitly enabled for authorized retrieval.
